description: This file implements a search integration for Perplexity's API within a larger search framework. It defines request structures, configuration, URL formation, request transformation, and response parsing specific to Perplexity's search API.

classes.name: PerplexitySearchRequest
classes.description: Data structure representing the request payload for Perplexity's search API with optional parameters.
